notes: v011 is underdetermined and resolves to the base; all three tokens are translated, so no rule 97 case arises.

promise* and God* are the ASV's own supplied words, and each completes the English of a token whose expression was still incomplete, so rule 7 folds them rather than rule 5 marking them added (rule 103's licensing test). ἣν heads on which because the relative is attributive here, the supplied noun being its antecedent rather than a nominal it substantivizes; heading on promise under rule 77's content test remains defensible.
The verse-opening And has no licensing token — ἧς is spent on this and no conjunction stands — so it is added under rules 5 and 86.
ἐν ἐκτενείᾳ → earnestly is one aligned unit on the noun: a noun does not spell an English adverb by itself, so rule 93's pleonastic arm is unavailable and rule 94's count test joins the pair.
